agent_runtime_state_valid.name: agent_runtime_state_valid
agent_runtime_state_valid.value: "agent_runtimes"."state" IN ('starting', 'active', 'stopped', 'blocked') AND "agent_runtimes"."agent_revision" > 0 AND "agent_runtimes"."strategy_version" > 0 AND "agent_runtimes"."segment" >= 0 AND "agent_runtimes"."failures" >= 0 AND "agent_runtimes"."input_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

chat_draft_source_valid.name: chat_draft_source_valid
chat_draft_source_valid.value: ("chat_agent_drafts"."source_type" = 'chat' AND "chat_agent_drafts"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_agent_drafts"."turn_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("chat_agent_drafts"."source_type" = 'manual' AND "chat_agent_drafts"."conversation_id" IS NULL AND "chat_agent_drafts"."turn_id" IS NULL)

defi_disposal_values.name: defi_disposal_values
defi_disposal_values.value: "defi_disposals"."quantity_units" > 0 AND "defi_disposals"."quantity_units" <= 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 AND ("defi_disposals"."basis_micro_usd" IS NULL OR "defi_disposals"."basis_micro_usd" >= 0) AND "defi_disposals"."principal_micro_usd" >= 0

defi_position_shape.name: defi_position_shape
defi_position_shape.value: "defi_positions"."scope" IN ('intents', 'confidential', 'native_near', 'hyperliquid') AND "defi_positions"."kind" IN ('lp_share', 'collateral', 'debt', 'staking', 'perp_long', 'perp_short') AND "defi_positions"."version" > 0 AND "defi_positions"."quantity_units" >= 0 AND "defi_positions"."quantity_units" <= 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 AND "defi_positions"."principal_micro_usd" >= 0 AND "defi_positions"."principal_micro_usd" <= 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 AND (("defi_positions"."kind" NOT IN ('debt', 'perp_long', 'perp_short')) OR "defi_positions"."principal_micro_usd" = 0) AND ("defi_positions"."quantity_units" > 0 OR "defi_positions"."principal_micro_usd" = 0)

execution_receipt_shape.name: execution_receipt_shape
execution_receipt_shape.value: "execution_receipts"."kind" IN ('swap', 'defi') AND "execution_receipts"."scope" IN ('intents', 'confidential', 'native_near', 'hyperliquid') AND "execution_receipts"."risk_debit_micro_usd" > 0 AND "execution_receipts"."risk_debit_micro_usd" <= 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 AND "execution_receipts"."receipt_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND octet_length("execution_receipts"."receipt_json") <= 96000

execution_action_amounts_positive.name: execution_action_amounts_positive
execution_action_amounts_positive.value:
"execution_actions"."notional_micro_usd" > 0 AND "execution_actions"."notional_micro_usd" <= 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 AND (
        ("execution_actions"."kind" = 'swap' AND "execution_actions"."input_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_actions"."output_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_actions"."input_asset_id" <> "execution_actions"."output_asset_id" AND "execution_actions"."input_units" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_actions"."min_output_units" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_actions"."input_units" > 0 AND "execution_actions"."min_output_units" > 0)
        OR ("execution_actions"."kind" = 'defi' AND "execution_actions"."input_asset_id" IS NULL AND "execution_actions"."output_asset_id" IS NULL AND "execution_actions"."input_units" IS NULL AND "execution_actions"."min_output_units" IS NULL))

execution_fill_amounts_valid.name: execution_fill_amounts_valid
execution_fill_amounts_valid.value: "execution_fills"."input_units" > 0 AND "execution_fills"."output_units" > 0 AND "execution_fills"."input_value_micro_usd" > 0 AND ("execution_fills"."fee_micro_usd" IS NULL OR "execution_fills"."fee_micro_usd" >= 0)

position_lot_basis_valid.name: position_lot_basis_valid
position_lot_basis_valid.value: ("position_lots"."initial_basis_micro_usd" IS NULL AND "position_lots"."remaining_basis_micro_usd" IS NULL) OR ("position_lots"."initial_basis_micro_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "position_lots"."remaining_basis_micro_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "position_lots"."initial_basis_micro_usd" >= 0 AND "position_lots"."remaining_basis_micro_usd" >= 0 AND "position_lots"."remaining_basis_micro_usd" <= "position_lots"."initial_basis_micro_usd")

position_realization_values_valid.name: position_realization_values_valid
position_realization_values_valid.value: ("position_realizations"."basis_micro_usd" IS NULL OR "position_realizations"."basis_micro_usd" >= 0) AND ("position_realizations"."net_proceeds_micro_usd" IS NULL OR "position_realizations"."net_proceeds_micro_usd" >= 0) AND "position_realizations"."principal_micro_usd" >= 0

position_realization_pnl_valid.name: position_realization_pnl_valid
position_realization_pnl_valid.value: ("position_realizations"."realized_pnl_micro_usd" IS NULL AND ("position_realizations"."basis_micro_usd" IS NULL OR "position_realizations"."net_proceeds_micro_usd" IS NULL)) OR ("position_realizations"."realized_pnl_micro_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "position_realizations"."basis_micro_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "position_realizations"."net_proceeds_micro_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "position_realizations"."realized_pnl_micro_usd" = "position_realizations"."net_proceeds_micro_usd" - "position_realizations"."basis_micro_usd")

telegram_challenge_claim_valid.name: telegram_challenge_claim_valid
telegram_challenge_claim_valid.value: ("telegram_link_challenges"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."telegram_user_id" IS NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."chat_id" IS NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."first_name" IS NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."username" IS NULL) OR ("telegram_link_challenges"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."telegram_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."chat_id" IS NOT NULL AND "telegram_link_challenges"."chat_id" = "telegram_link_challenges"."telegram_user_id" AND "telegram_link_challenges"."telegram_user_id" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$' AND "telegram_link_challenges"."first_name" IS NOT NULL)

trading_account_keys_valid.name: trading_account_keys_valid
trading_account_keys_valid.value: ("trading_accounts"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "trading_accounts"."sealed_keys" IS NOT NULL) OR ("trading_accounts"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trading_accounts"."sealed_keys" IS NULL)

trading_account_backup_valid.name: trading_account_backup_valid
trading_account_backup_valid.value: ("trading_accounts"."backup_confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "trading_accounts"."backup_file_hash" IS NULL) OR ("trading_accounts"."backup_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trading_accounts"."backup_file_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "trading_accounts"."backup_file_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

wallet_funding_confirmation_valid.name: wallet_funding_confirmation_valid
wallet_funding_confirmation_valid.value: ("wallet_fundings"."state" IN ('prepared','wallet_pending') AND "wallet_fundings"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "wallet_fundings"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "wallet_fundings"."action_id" IS NULL) OR ("wallet_fundings"."state" IN ('deposited','converting','complete') AND "wallet_fundings"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_fundings"."transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_fundings"."wallet_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL)
